description: UL Research Institutes produced measurements from eighteen full-scale passenger-vehicle fire experiments at its Northbrook, Illinois, laboratory. The Data in Brief article compares battery-electric and gasoline vehicles in free-burn and suppression conditions, using eight vehicle models from six manufacturers. It describes gas temperature, heat flux, vehicle mass, smoke and particulate measurements, and waterflow during suppression. The named Figshare API record lists eighteen experiment ZIPs, instrument and vehicle CSV tables, and a README. DataCite and Figshare both state CC BY-NC 4.0; access is free with a non-commercial reuse restriction. Coverage is controlled laboratory fires, not a population sample of road crashes, garages or charging stations. A known limitation is that the ignition method, selected vehicles, laboratory ventilation and suppression setup limit direct transfer to field fire frequency or consequences. A reviewer-assessed use is checking thermal-hazard assumptions for emergency-response or transport-facility simulations. data-nist-fire-calorimetry-database is a related fire-measurement collection, without a verified common apparatus. The Figshare item API returned the metadata and file inventory; its human-facing landing returned HTTP 202 without content. No experiment archive, PDF or CSV was downloaded.
